title: Perpetua Resources Provides Construction Update on the Stibnite Gold Project and Exploration Activities
summary: Perpetua Resources Corp. (Nasdaq: PPTA) (TSX: PPTA) ("Perpetua Resources," "Perpetua," or the "Company") today provided an update on critical path construction progress at its Stibnite Gold Project (the "Project") in central Idaho. With federal approvals secured in 2025 and early works and critical path construction activities underway, the Company is pleased to provide updates to shareholders and communities with a clear view of activity on the ground.

title: Perpetua Resources Reports New High-Grade Gold and Antimony Discoveries and a New Gold-Tungsten Zone at Stibnite
summary: Perpetua Resources Corp. title: Perpetua Resources, US Army, and Idaho National Laboratory Launch Critical Minerals Pilot Plant to Advance Antimony Trisulfide Supply
summary: Perpetua Resources Corp.
